title: Anthologies of the Spoudastirion Neou Ellinismou (snhell.gr) — Cretan Greek lyric poetry
notes: Three Cretan poems (dedications to Chortatsis' Erofili and Panoria and Foskolos' Fortounatos) from the online anthology of the Spoudastirion Neou Ellinismou (snhell.gr; text from Kritiki Lyriki Poiisi, Ermis 1999), harvested through the Wayback Machine. The host snhell.gr no longer resolves; the entry points to an archived snapshot of Chortatsis' page (2025), and the Foskolos text is at https://web.archive.org/web/20250809221230/http://www.snhell.gr/anthology/content.asp?id=46&author_id=54. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Spoudastirion Neou Ellinismou (Athens); site no longer online, archived at the Wayback Machine
